name: FiGram for Telegram
summary:
FiGram for Telegram is an unofficial client for Telegram, made for a floating window in your headset. Sign in with the Telegram account you already have and read, write and watch without picking up your phone.

FEATURES
• Sign in with your phone number and the login code Telegram sends you. Scanning a QR code with the Telegram app on your phone works as an alternative.
• Chat list with your folders, archive, pinned chats and unread counters.
• Read and write messages. Reply, forward, and edit or delete your
